missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Корова' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'пасётся'. 'Большая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на лугу' gives the location. A simple descriptive card.
Strategic focus: Accusative of an animate noun. 'Корову' is the accusative direct object of 'ведёт'. For a feminine noun this ending differs from the nominative, and 'в поле' shows direction.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Коровы' takes the genitive after 'нет' to mark non-existence. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine genitive, showing ownership. A standard negation frame.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Корове' takes the dative as the recipient of the action 'дала'. 'Траву' is the accusative direct object. A clean give-to pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'гордиться'. 'Коровой' takes the instrumental required by the verb 'гордиться'. 'Своей' agrees in the feminine instrumental. A useful verb-government pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О корове' uses the prepositional 'корове' after 'о' to express talking about the cow. 'Больной' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after 'три'. After the numeral 'три' the feminine noun takes the genitive singular 'коровы'. 'На ферме' sets the place. A key number-noun rule.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural of an animate noun. 'Коров' is the genitive-form accusative plural, since животных in the plural take the genitive ending. 'Всех' agrees, and 'утром' fixes the time.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Коровы' is the nominative plural subject of 'дают'. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'много молока' takes the genitive after a quantity word.

missions.phrase: Пастух идёт за коровами на пастбище.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental plural with 'за'. 'За коровами' uses the instrumental plural 'коровами' to mean going after the cows. 'На пастбище' shows direction. A useful preposition pattern.
